tiers.name: Local reference
tiers.scope: one machine, synthetic demo or your own declared inventory and local sources

tiers.name: Read-only connected pilot
tiers.scope: isolated non-production deployment with scoped source keys and read-only provider grants
not_included: live provider validation beyond the pilot record

tiers.name: Team investigation
tiers.scope: several analysts, OIDC subjects, cases, two-person approval, notification outbox
not_included: validated SSO against a real identity provider
validated delivery to a real notification destination

tiers.name: Optional lab response
tiers.scope: a laboratory-only executor for approved plans
not_included: any executor: R08.3 is not built

integrations.name: Digital Kingdom event API / @dk/sdk-node
integrations.permissions: project source key: listed assets and actions only
integrations.limits: application assertions; does not prove outcomes
integrations.troubleshooting: 422 lists rejected fields; check Coverage for last receipt
integrations.uninstall: disable the source (POST /sources/:id/state) and revoke its key

integrations.name: OpenTelemetry traces (OTLP/HTTP JSON)
integrations.limits: JSON encoding only; sampled traces are not unsampled coverage
integrations.uninstall: remove the exporter, disable the source

integrations.name: AWS CloudTrail (one account)
integrations.permissions: read-only CloudTrail lookup and IAM read for snapshots
integrations.limits: fixture-validated; live account validation pending authorized access
integrations.uninstall: delete the read role, disable the source

integrations.name: Falco runtime alerts (http_output)
integrations.limits: an alert proves a rule match, not intent or effect
integrations.troubleshooting: check Falco http_output URL and key

integrations.name: Declared inventory (manifest / Docker Compose)
integrations.limits: declared dependencies, not discovered runtime paths

integrations.name: GitHub repository discovery
integrations.limits: declared metadata; previews must be applied explicitly

integrations.name: Edge/API, workload, data/RAG, SaaS sample-data packs
integrations.limits: no live feeds until authorized provider access

integrations.name: Signed HTTPS notification webhook
integrations.troubleshooting: Integrations -> Notifications shows failures and last error

integrations.name: MCP (local stdio)
integrations.limits: answers queries; not a watching agent; no remote MCP
integrations.uninstall: remove from the MCP client config, revoke the token

compatibility.database: SQLite (node:sqlite), forward-only migrations; restore from backup to roll back
compatibility.api: /api v1; contract ids are versioned (dk.*.v1/v2) and never change meaning in place
